context: Batch importer reads every CSV file in a directory and processes each one sequentially. The directory may contain hundreds of files.
explanation: defer f.Close() inside the loop does not run until ImportAll returns — all file descriptors stay open simultaneously, potentially hitting the OS open-file limit and causing failures on large directories. Fix: extract the per-file logic into a helper function so the defer runs after each file, or close the file explicitly before the next iteration.
